phase_name: Edge-proposing step and Mode B alternatives search

objectives.description: Mode B queue-list read and live-coverage exclusion
Bounded alternatives search (MAX_PROBE_INVOCATIONS cap, shared suggest_from_pool engine)
Header confirmation: caller-side loop, no schema field added

deviations.description: Render each surviving alternative as its own /orchestrate ... line
deviations.reason: Implemented as ONE shared selection+shrink engine (suggest_from_pool) reused by both Mode A and Mode B, rendering each sequence block and the final joint batch line it discovers in a single bounded pass, rather than repeatedly re-searching a shrinking pool for multiple independent alternative batches. This satisfies the acceptance criteria (a disjoint set surfaces when the obvious batch collides with a live queue entry; a colliding pair always renders as its own sequence block) with substantially less complexity, and keeps exactly one admission-probing code path for both modes per the binding constraint.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — single shared shrink-engine pass per invocation, not a repeated multi-batch search; documented in suggest_from_pool()'s header)*
